d:
Instant Sabudana Vada, the perfect recipe for when you don’t have time to soak sabudana or simply forgot to soak it in advance! These vadas turn out incredibly delicious, super crispy on the outside and beautifully fluffy on the inside.
It’s also completely vrat-friendly, making it perfect for your Navratri fast. I’ve also shared an incredible green chutney that pairs beautifully with the vadas and is definitely worth making. The full written recipe is mentioned below in the description. Happy Navratri to all of you!
